# AGENTS.md — Bootgly framework

This file is for agents changing **the framework itself** — this repository.

- The contributor rules (layers, conventions, the native test runner, gates, docs and commits) live in
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

Building an application **with** Bootgly? These are not your rules. The framework reaches you as the
pinned, read-only `Bootgly/` submodule of a kit: open your agent in the kit (`bootgly.kit/`) and follow
its `AGENTS.md`.
